name: Catalpic acid
description: Catalpic acid (CAS 4337-71-7 ) is a naturally occurring conjugated trienoic fatty acid found in seed oils of the Catalpa genus. In industry, it functions as a bioactive lipid component with antioxidant activity. This material is highly relevant to formulators working with specialty fatty acid fractions and functional oil ingredients. In food and nutrition, it is evaluated as a functional lipid for use in enriched oils. Dietary supplement formulations often target this compound for its specific conjugated fatty acid content. Personal care formulators incorporate it into skin-conditioning preparations for enhanced performance. Conjugated fatty acids contribute to oxidative stability and bioactive performance in various topical applications. Pharmaceutical researchers use it as a reference compound and active ingredient candidate. It is currently under investigation for lipid-based formulations in metabolic applications. It also serves as a specialty ingredient in cosmetic emulsions where the fatty acid profile is a key selection criterion. The product is available primarily as a neat liquid fatty acid or dissolved in carrier oil matrices. This reflects its natural occurrence in Catalpa seed oil fractions and ensures stability during transport. Supply is typically offered at research and specialty-grade purity levels for industrial use. High-purity isolates are available for pharmaceutical and analytical reference use to meet strict requirements. Quantities range from milligram-scale reference standards to small bulk lots.
